notes: No row recorded: none of the Table 8-1 values could be read from the report itself, and the rules forbid working from memory or from secondary copies. What was verified in the primary source (DTIC PDF, first 88,845 characters): the report is CG-D-08-99, April 1999, Allen and Plourde, USCG R&D Center; Table 8-1 is titled 'Recommended Leeway Speed and Direction Values for Search Planning Tools' and starts on page 8-5, inside section 8.3 'Recommendations for Leeway Guidance for the Manual Method' (pp. 8-4 to 8-13); the Executive Summary (p. vii) says 63 new leeway classes are recommended and that 'the values for the leeway equations are presented in Appendix B' (Table B-1 'Cross-Reference of Leeway Drift Objects', p. B1-1). So a reader needs pages 8-4 to 8-13 and Appendix B; the table may span several pages. Table 2-3 (pp. 2-8 to 2-11, 'Objects that have been field tested for leeway values') names the object classes the task lists (PIW (65 kg); PIW vertical with PFD; Switlik and Avon 4-person and Tulmar 4-person life rafts; Switlik 6-person raft; 12 ft Silver Skiff; 5.6 m open plank boat; Sea Kayak; Surfboards (Chapline 1960); Wind-surfer board) but carries no leeway values. Why it stopped: the fetch tool converts only the first part of any PDF (88,845 characters here; 100,111 and 120,510 for two other PDFs, so the cap is on file size or pages, not characters), and every other route to the later pages failed: DTIC's newer /sti/tr/pdf/ and citation paths error out, the 2005 report is not served at any DTIC path tried, and the Internet Archive's OCR text file (which exists, 568.8K) needed a permission nobody could answer in time. The 2005 'equivalent' (Allen, Leeway Divergence, CG-D-05-05, DTIC ADA435435, 128 pages) is listed by NTRL and Google Books but no readable copy was reachable. Suggested fixes for a rerun: add the archive.org full-text URL (https://archive.org/stream/DTIC_ADA366414/DTIC_ADA366414_djvu.txt) to the task inputs so it has provenance, or have a person download it and paste pages 8-4 to 8-13; or obtain the 2005 report through the NTRL download button. Also worth knowing: the Coast Guard's current table is Table H-7 (p. H-28) of the SAR Addendum COMDTINST M16130.2F (2013), which postdates both reports and may differ from Table 8-1; record which edition any value comes from. The context row hf-radar-search-area was not touched: nothing opened here bears on it.
